messages:
Oncall Bot: PAGER: genqueue-west high-tail-latency (p99 > 1.5s) + elevated 5xx rate. Paging @Mia Chen @Devon Patel. Link to incident: https://redwood/incident/INC-20260302-01 :rotating_light:
Mia Chen: ack — joining bridge now. grabbing logs and timeline.
Devon Patel: i’m on logs, seeing frequent tokenizer worker pauses, lots of "GC pause" messages. memory growth on tokenizer-1 pods.
Oncall Bot: bridge created: https://zoom/bridge-1234. Runbook ref: /runbooks/genqueue-tail-latency.md
Alex Rivera: drafting initial statuspage copy below — please quick review/send.
Alex Rivera: ```Initial update: We are investigating elevated error rates and high latency for text generation requests in US-West. Some requests may fail or experience delays. Our engineers are actively investigating and mitigating. Impact: ~10-20% of generation requests for certain customers. Mitigation steps: rolling restarts of tokenizer workers and partial failover to US-East. Next update: 20 minutes.```
Priya K (CS): pls avoid naming customers publicly. we should add a line: "Customers using dedicated capacity may see different impact". Also asking for list of affected customers to notify privately.
Alex Rivera: updated: added that line and removed numeric percent range -> replaced with "a subset of requests" per legal. new draft below:
Alex Rivera: ```Initial update: We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for text generation requests in US-West. A subset of requests may fail or experience delays. Our engineers are actively investigating and mitigating. Mitigation steps underway: rolling restarts of tokenizer workers and partial failover to US-East. We will post updates every ~20 minutes.```
Legal - Sam: +1 to removing SLA or outage wording. ok to publish this.
Mia Chen: action plan: 1) restart tokenizer-1 deployment in us-west (canary 2 pods) 2) if errors persist, trigger routing to us-east for new requests 3) gather customer list for CS. Starting step 1 now.
SRE Rotation: logging restart command we ran: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/tokenizer-1 -n genqueue-usw```
Devon Patel: after canary: memory growth stopped on those pods, but still seeing spikes on older nodes. initiating controlled drain on pods >= 72h uptime.
Priya K (CS): Priya to notify top 5 customers via private channel once we confirm partial mitigation. pls DM me the customer IDs.
Oncall Bot: Publishing initial status page now -> status.redwood.com/incidents/GEN-20260302 (draft published).
Alex Rivera: scheduling follow-up updates at +20m and +40m. I'll post suggested copy here for review.
-- 20m update --
Alex Rivera: ```Update (20m): Mitigation in progress. We restarted tokenizer workers in US-West and began routing a portion of new requests to US-East. Error rates have decreased from initial spike; some users may still see intermittent failures. Engineers continue to monitor and roll out additional restarts. Next update: 20 minutes.```
Mia Chen: metrics show error rate reduced to ~3.5% for gen requests in US-West, p99 down to ~850ms. still above normal but trending down.
Devon Patel: captures from logs: root-cause candidate is a memory leak in tokenizer v1.3.2 during specific unicode path handling. collecting repro and opening a bug.
Legal - Sam: please keep the public message high-level; we can reference a post-incident report later.
Alex Rivera: posting the 20m update to status page.
Priya K (CS): sent private notes to affected customers with suggested mitigations (retry/backoff) and our ETA.
-- 40m update / resolve --
Mia Chen: rolled back tokenizer to v1.3.1 in us-west and rebalanced traffic. watching for regressions.
Devon Patel: after rollback, error rate returned to baseline (<0.5%), p99 ~120ms. tagging root cause as tokenizer memory leak in v1.3.2.
Alex Rivera: draft resolved notice below — review:```Resolved: The issue affecting text generation in US-West has been resolved. We identified a memory leak in tokenizer v1.3.2 that caused worker pauses and elevated error rates. We rolled back affected tokenizer services to v1.3.1 and rebalanced traffic; normal service has been restored. We will follow up with a post-incident report outlining root cause and next steps.```
Priya K (CS): sending resolved note to affected customers and offering extended support windows for any follow-ups.
Legal - Sam: ok to publish resolved. good to include link to post-incident report when ready.
Oncall Bot: status page set to "resolved" and final notice published. incident closed in pager system.
Mia Chen: filing incident ticket with timeline and attaching logs + heap dumps. tagging for remediation (fix in tokenizer v1.3.3 and rollout gating).
Devon Patel: opened bug: https://tracker/tokenizer/BUG-9876 with repro and heap traces. assigning to @eng-ml for patch.
SRE Rotation: great job team. adding retrospective to next oncall retro. :clap:
